text:
Devon Lee: quick ping — PR ready for a few pairs of eyes, small prop rename in the JS REST client that's surfaced in a couple of downstream places. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789

Maria Gomez: taking a look now, is this just a rename or is behavior changing?

Devon Lee: purely a rename: `sessionToken` -> `session_id`. updated types and one util that builds the toolcall headers. No logic change, but it touches the toolcall header mapping so wanted extra attention.

Kevin O'Connor: skimmed the diff, looks straightforward. Can you paste the shim you added for backwards compat?

Devon Lee: yup — small shim, added in client/compat.ts:
```ts
export function normalizeSessionKey(opts: any) {
  // prefer new name, fallback to old for older callers
  return opts.session_id ?? opts.sessionToken ?? null;
}
```

Sarah Nguyen: my concern was e2e for streaming+toolcall. Did you run the integration harness?

Devon Lee: ran the local e2e harness against staging runtime, toolcall headers looked correct. CI ran unit + integration smoke and passed.

CI-Bot: All checks passed — 18 successful, 0 failed.

Maria Gomez: two small asks: 1) add a changelog blurb in `CHANGELOG.md` noting the rename and compat shim, 2) add a unit test asserting header uses `session_id` when provided.

Devon Lee: will add both, thanks.

Kevin O'Connor: happy to approve after the changelog/test. quick note: consider semver minor since it's API surface even if backward compatible.

Ryan Tran: tagging to merge queue — once Maria approves and CI stays green, I can cut the merge.

Devon Lee: added test + changelog in new commit, ptal: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789/commits/5f3b9c

Maria Gomez: LGTM, test covers header and fallback, changelog ok. :thumbsup:

Ryan Tran: merging when green, will follow up if any post-merge canary issues.

Devon Lee: thanks all!
